home.slogan: Your companion for finding toys on eBay
home.lede: Whether it's a graded card, a rare Lego, or a carded figure, we help you search, watch, and buy the piece you're looking for.
home.watchBody: You share the piece and the precise criteria. We watch for you, and alert you on your schedule: a new listing, a daily note, or a weekly recap.
home.seeBody: Search is quick and obvious. Every listing shows a confidence score, a price score, and the price to your door. Nothing hidden.
home.buyBody: We curate for collectors, not a faster marketplace. When it is worth it, you buy.

search.label: Search collectibles

filters.unofficialHelp: When this is on, we ask eBay to skip custom, replica, fake, MOC, compatible, unlicensed, and other unofficial listings so we maximize your chances to see the real pieces.

settings.title: Settings
